title.es: El de cuando Pelayo reprocha a Marta
title.en: The One Where Pelayo Reproaches Marta

description.es: Pelayo le reprocha a Marta que le haya contado a Andrés lo de Santiago. Encima, le dice que Fina la dejó porque era una cobarde, y que, si la quisiera, se la habría llevado con ella.
description.en: Pelayo reproaches Marta for telling Andrés about the Santiago incident. On top of that, he says that Fina left her because she was a coward, and that if she loved her she would have taken her along.
